morphology.pattern_note: segak 是完整词根，不能拆成 se- + gak。e 为 é 音 /e/，常见马来西亚读音中词尾 k 实现为 [ʔ]。数据包的 gak 及爪夷文片段 ݢق 均不完整，此处修正。

word_family.gloss: 使精神体面；使恢复健康

senses.zh_definition: 仪表英俊、穿着得体而显得精神挺拔的；潇洒的。
senses.en_definition: Handsome, smartly dressed, or distinguished in appearance.
senses.nuances: 常形容男性，也常突出服装、仪容与姿态带来的精神面貌；不必然指面部容貌。此词的 e 读 é。另有用于派生词 menyegak、表示呵斥的同形词条，不应混入本形容词义。依据：[DBP segak 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=segak)。

senses.zh_definition: 病后已经康复的；身体健康而精神焕发的。
senses.en_definition: Recovered from illness; healthy and refreshed.
senses.ms_definition: Sembuh daripada sakit; segar dan sihat.
senses.nuances: 词典收录此义，但日常交谈中 sihat、pulih 或 sembuh 通常更明确。不能把所有外貌赞美自动理解成病后康复。依据：[DBP segak 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=segak)。

collocations.en: to feel healthy and refreshed again

dual_scenarios.ms: Para peserta kelihatan segak dalam pakaian seragam masing-masing semasa majlis perbarisan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 参加者在阅队仪式上身穿各自的制服，显得精神挺拔。
dual_scenarios.en: The participants looked smart in their respective uniforms during the parade ceremony.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友称赞婚宴穿搭
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Wah, segaklah kau pakai baju Melayu ni!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Wah, awak kelihatan segak apabila memakai baju Melayu ini!
dual_scenarios.zh: 哇，你穿这身马来传统服装真帅！
dual_scenarios.en: Wow, you look really sharp in that baju Melayu!
spoken_features: lah 在此加强赞美语气
kau 用于熟悉的朋友之间

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Wah, segaklah kau pakai baju Melayu ni! Dah siap nak pergi kenduri ke?
messages.ms_standard: Wah, awak kelihatan segak apabila memakai baju Melayu ini! Adakah awak sudah bersedia untuk pergi ke kenduri?
messages.zh: 哇，你穿这身真帅！准备好去吃喜酒啦？
messages.en: Wow, you look sharp in that baju Melayu! All ready for the wedding?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Terima kasih! Dah, tunggu adik je. Dia tengah cari kasut.
messages.ms_standard: Terima kasih! Saya sudah bersedia dan hanya menunggu adik. Dia sedang mencari kasut.
messages.zh: 谢谢！准备好了，就等我弟弟呢。他还在找鞋。
messages.en: Thanks! I'm ready—just waiting for my little brother. He's looking for his shoes.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two connected-looking senses of segak: an impressive appearance and restored health. Together they offer a cultural picture of someone looking vigorous, well presented, and full of life. This is a useful semantic association, rather than proof that one sense historically developed from the other. A deeper borrowing origin is not established here. See [DBP definitions](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=segak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se-gak 想成穿好礼服、挺直身板的两拍动作：仪容整齐，精神挺拔——segak！

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称赞朋友、亲属或新郎穿着精神很自然。与不熟悉的同事交谈时，称赞 pakaian kemas 等具体穿着通常更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 常用于婚宴、开斋节、毕业典礼和制服场合。称赞宜简短得体；不要把外貌评价变成反复打趣，也不要将大写的学校体能评估简称 SEGAK 与本词混为一谈。
